questions.question: If tan A = (3)/(4), then the value of (cos A - sin A)/(cos A + sin A) is:

cos A = side adjacent to A/Hypotenuse

sin A = side opposite to A/Hypotenuse

In triangle ABC

⇒ (AC)² = (4)² + (3)²

⇒ (AC)² = 16 + 9

⇒ (AC)² = 25

⇒ AC = 5 units

cos A = AB/AC

⇒ 4/5

sin A = BC/AC

⇒ 3/5

[(4/5) - (3/5)]/[(4/5) + (3/5)]

⇒ [(4 - 3)/5]/[(4 + 3)/5]

⇒ [(1/5)]/[(7/5)]

⇒ (1/5) × (5/7)

⇒ 1/7

**∴ The value of (cos A - sin A)/(cos A + sin A) is 1/7**

questions.question: Hindi was declared as the official language of Union under Article _______ of Indian Constitution.

• **Article 343(2)** stated that English would continue to be used in official Union activities for a period of 15 years from the date of the constitution's inception, i.e. until January 25, 1965.
 
• Again, **article 343(3) **empowered the parliament to pass laws to ensure that English would continue to be spoken after January 25, 1965.
 
• Both Houses of Parliament passed the Official Language Resolution on January 18, 1968.
 
• This Resolution was approved to create a comprehensive programme for the Union of India to expand the use of the Hindu language for official purposes.
 
• As a result, the Official Languages Act of 1963 was passed, allowing English to be used after the stated date of 1965.

**Calculation**

(8 + 27 + 64 + ..... + 1000)

2³ + 3³ + 4³ + .... + 10³

as these is a series of cube of first 10 natural number except 1 . Let take n = 10 and subtract 1 from the above mentioned formula.

⇒ [5(11)]² - 1

⇒ [55]² - 1

⇒ 3025 - 1

⇒ 3024 ---- (1)

(2 + 4 + 6 + .... + 20)

This series is an arithmetic progression. As common difference, d = 2 i.e. (4 - 2= 2; 6 - 4 = 2)

aₙ = a + (n - 1)d

⇒ 20 = 2 + (n - 1)2

⇒ 20 = 2 + 2n - 2

⇒ 20 = 2n

n = 10

⇒ 5 [4 + 18]

⇒ 5 [22]

adding 1 and 2

⇒ 3134

**∴ (8 + 27 + 64 + ... + 1000) + (2 + 4 + 6 + ... + 20) is 3134**.
